name: Arm circles
description: Extend your arms to the sides and make small circles, gradually increasing their size.

name: Band row
description: Anchor a band and pull toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.

name: Wall push-up
description: Place your hands on a wall and push your body away, keeping a straight line from head to heels.

name: Push-up to row
description: From a push-up, row one dumbbell up with each arm while keeping your hips level.

name: Seated dumbbell press
description: Sit tall and press dumbbells overhead, then lower them to shoulder height.

name: Plank row
description: From a plank on dumbbells, row one weight up while keeping your hips still.

name: Single-arm dumbbell press
description: Press one dumbbell overhead while keeping your core braced.

name: Weighted pull-up
description: Hang from a bar with extra load and pull your chin over it.
caution: Lower slowly and keep the shoulders packed. Stop if you feel elbow pain.

name: Clean and press
description: Lift a barbell from the floor to your shoulders in one motion, then press it overhead.
caution: Learn the movement with light weight first. Keep the trunk braced.

name: Heavy push press
description: Use a leg drive to help press a heavy weight overhead.
caution: Use a squat rack and safety bars. Keep the bar close.
